# C16 reference fixtures

Small synthetic CS50 inputs are generated by scripts/job_control_demo.build_inputs
inside each test's new temporary directory. They run the actual existing
make_plan/HTML-v2/receipt/quality contracts, without downloads or LLMs.

c15-metrics-reference.v1.json is a **published protocol snapshot** from PR 65,
commit e74d3405. It is test data only; it does not copy/import the unmerged C15
implementation or assume it is on master. Compatibility checks allow the
explicitly documented C16 queue-length extension.

Process fault probes in tests/helpers/job_control_probe.py are trusted test
code. They are never registered as jobs, never accept requests from HTTP and
only create bounded temporary synthetic processes/files.
